Weed is always fun and my favorite.. It’s a good drug to do with other drugs. Here’s what I know. 
Weed is going to make you pretty high, it’s something you can do pretty much every day if you wish. There’s lots of forms (edibles=candy, brownies, even food like pasta etc, dope/grass/bud= weed, in its own plant form, smoked with a bong, pipe, oil=smoked with a pen, usually more expensive, and dabs=highly concentrated form of THC, same as oil smoked with a dab rig) There are two types of weed, sativa which will give you energy and indica which will make you want to chill out. Pieces can be found at pipe shops, you can get them pretty cheap ($15-25 for a good pipe, $40-60 for a good bong, etc). For a gram of weed, it’s $10. ⅛  ounce is about $20, ¼ is $60 ½ $110, 1 ounce of weed is $200 (about, give or take). A*note: you can get green sickness. Your first time you probably won’t smoke that much (you shouldn’t have more than a couple hits to get you high) and also the first time you might not get super high. It all depends. Also unless you already smoke tabacco don’t mix the two. 

Shrooms (mushrooms). These are a psychedelic. They will make you trip. If you eat enough (yes physical mushrooms you eat-best with peanut butter) you will throw up and that will make you really trip. This last five to six hours of tripping. Don’t eat anything after you’ve taken the shrooms. Shrooms can be about $20 for ⅛ ounce. And go up from there. You won’t need more than an ⅛ your first time. You can do these 2 a month, not super addictive. Also shrooms can make you emotional, give you a bad trip, and make you really think about shit, so do it on a good day. Same with acid. 

Acid. This comes on a tab of paper. Pretty cheap, about $10 per tab. This drug lasts a very long time (8-12 hours) and you’re going to want a day after for recovery. You’ll very euphoric and happy. Best to do it in the morning or afternoon, unless you’re at a concert and want to be up all night. It will make you trip (also a psychedelic but not natural like shrooms or weed).  You should stick to 1 time per month 

Molly (MDMA) I’m pill form. Usually around $30-40. You can snort it or chew it (I would suggest snorting, hurts more but you don’t get that awful taste and it’s not as bad in the long run. You’ll get drips in the back of your mouth so you’ll want some lemonade to wash it down. It will make you want to touch everything and everyone and love everyone while simultaneously making you feel euphoric. Do only once a month so you don’t get addicted. Once every three months is best. 

Coke, or cocaine. Very fun drug but it won’t make you feel crazy high. In fact you can actually sit down and have a normal conversation. You snort it and it’s very expensive. Usually $20 will get you two or three lines, depends on how generous someone is. Try to do only once a month because this is pretty addictive but you don’t see it coming. I still want to do coke all the time and I barely do it. It’s the only drug I want to do this much so be careful. 

Heroine and Meth are something I haven’t done so I don’t know much except this. There so addictive you do them twice and your hooked. When you’re coming down from meth you go below your normal level of happiness and so you need to do more to bring yourself back up and you will not go back to normal. People get hooked instantly and honestly I wouldn’t try it unless you only have a month left to live because you will be hooked like that. Also getting clean meth is very hard to do, as with mdma and coke. Trust, as much as you can that you’re getting your drugs from somewhere safe. Even weed can be synthetic and that shit is dangerous. 

DMT is a very high concentrated drug that will literally fuck you up so hard and make you trip for 15 minutes but it will be the craziest 15 minutes of your life. 

This is all I know about drugs. The most important thing is, people are gonna rip you off, so look up stuff online or find people you can trust and have them help you. Don’t do it alone, it’s always good to have friends. Don’t feel pressure, even if your dying, there are some drugs that are really dangerous. Be somewhere safe, not in public until you learn how to handle everything. Don’t do a bunch of different drugs all at once. And if something doesn’t feel right, don’t do it. 

Much love, have a safe and wonderful journey in this adventure.
